description.text:
Seven single-target Earth/NE magical attacks (? each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Earth with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], & Crystal Force Mode: Rinoa (Earth) to the user
Crystal Force Mode: Rinoa (Earth): Earth Ability Boost, Dualcast Earth, Zero Hone Cost to Earth Abilities & 25% DEF/RES Pierce
Crystal Force I: 4 single-target Earth/NE magic attacks (? each) capped at 19999, grants [Damage Cap +10000 1] [Earth Ability Damage +50% 1] [Quick ATB 1]  & [50% DEF/RES Pierce 1] for 1 turn to user; Crystal Force II: Chases with 2 single-target Earth/NE Overflow magic attacks (? each),[Quick Earth 1] & [Triplecast Earth 1] to user with at least 0 Witches/ [Instant Earth 1] & [Quadruplecast Earth 1] to user with at least 3 Witches
